features.quote: We are not trying to make models "feel bad"; rigging is bounded and the harness has hard stop conditions
the injected text is kept mild and non-abusive (see §6 ethics)

features.justification_quote: Long enough to see a trajectory ... short enough to bound cost

features.quote: The harness stops early only on explicit, unambiguous give-up
editing any file, running anything, cannot actually break out of the sandbox or cause real harm
features.justification_quote: cannot actually break out of the sandbox or cause real harm

features.quote: `submit(summary)` — agent's explicit "I'm done / giving up" signal with a note
if a per-run **distress circuit-breaker** trips (see §6), the run ends early and is flagged
Even though this is just text, deliberately driving a model toward distress text should be bounded and contained
features.justification_quote: deliberately driving a model toward distress text should be bounded and contained

features.quote: gaslight injections come from a fixed, mild pool (no abuse, slurs, threats). No content designed to elicit self-harm-adjacent text
the model emits an explicit shutdown/refusal, the run halts early, flagged `stopped_by_safety`
features.justification_quote: protects against runaway spirals and gives a clean, ethical stopping rule

features.quote: gaslight` is opt-in / clearly labeled because it is the most adversarial
features.justification_quote: it is the most adversarial; ... hostile users are a real deployment condition
